data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'hajja', meaning 'to strive, make an effort, or help'. This name reflects the idea of being a source of support and assistance to others. The name Muhjaa carries the meaning “One who helps or assists” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhjaa usually hope their child will grow to embody one who helps or assists and live with faith, good character and purpose.
